title: A bookshop website
message: Our fictional bookshop needs a website to display reading events and a catalogue. Can we discuss which features to include?

saved.summary: Fictional bookshop wants an events page and catalogue.
saved.reply_draft: Thank you for sharing the idea. Please clarify how the catalogue will be updated and whether event bookings are required. A person must review scope before discussing next steps.
saved.review_reason: Bookings and catalogue ownership need human clarification.

title: A workshop workflow
message: Our fictional craft workshop wants to automate weekly stock reminders. We currently keep a spreadsheet and need help defining the workflow.

saved.summary: Fictional craft workshop wants spreadsheet stock reminders.
saved.reply_draft: Please clarify where the spreadsheet is stored, how stock thresholds are set, and who should review reminders. No automation or message sending has been activated.
clarification_questions: Where is the stock spreadsheet stored?
saved.review_reason: Data access and reminder rules require manual review.

title: An idea needing clarification
message: Our fictional community club needs an app and a website, but we have not decided what members should be able to do. How should we start?

saved.summary: Fictional club has an early idea spanning app and website.
saved.reply_draft: Please describe the main problem for members and the first task you want to improve. A person can review priorities before any scope is agreed.
clarification_questions: What is the first task members need to complete?
